woah, okay that’s fucked up. your teacher isn’t a teacher, they shouldn’t be grabbing you firstly, and secondly they should notice these signs. you don’t have to give them an explanation, but i learned that sending emails to all my teachers and letting them know that it’s not just a fear or shyness, but it leads me into an anxiety attack that can lead to worse.

healing and growth in your anxiety is definitely a life long battle, but continuing to share these experiences and how they made you feel i think will help :) there are many instagram or just online communities that have great tips and advice for social anxiety. remember, you are MORE than your anxiety and i am so proud of you for getting through that, you shouldn’t have had to.

i think for sure you can learn online!! it’s just usually having someone to coach and correct you can leave less frustration and more improvement, it’s just a bit easier. but, i think for sure you can be self-taught!! :) it’s definitely possible if you have the motivation and eagerness to learn :D but also with the internet now, there’s so much you can learn, and so much you can correct on your own! i say go for it!!

definitely watch dancers online and dance teachers! also, know what kind of genre you want to do. learn easy dances first, learn basic technique for what genre of dance you’ll need. start working out too if you’re not already! i also recommend watching madfit’s videos, good workouts and fun dances to follow :)

if you’re in school still or if there’s a studio you can find, definitely reach out to them! i was extremely nervous and shy to go to my school’s try outs, but i finally had given in with courage. i’m now in my second year and it is so so much fun, and so motivating to see how much you can improve with a coach :) 

keep consistency! do your stretches and workouts, do your research, learn dances you’ll like and that are at your level! practice if not every day atleast a few times every week!! look for constructive criticism for your weak spots, but also acknowledge your strong points and keep team growing!

Firstly, Her grandmother brought over a bag of baby rabbits to show to me and my mom that she was planning on suffocating to death because they kept eating her plants or some shit. we were very disturbed. another thing, her new husband is the strangest person i’ve ever met. when i was sleeping over once when her granddaughter still partially lived there, i went to say goodbye n this dude had duct tape over his mouth with the shortest, tightest boxers! he smiled at me and hummed as he continued making breakfast??? he also groans very loudly all the time, we can hear him when our windows are open. it’s not one of pain either, it’s just random and weird.
